sprite: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production sprite atlas for a cheerful Korean children's 2D side-scrolling platform game. Create one transparent-background atlas with EXACTLY SIX full-body poses of the SAME Merong King, organized as a uniform 3 columns by 2 rows grid, no lines or captions. Character based on a child's drawing: a very wide rounded half-circle smiling head/body, two tiny dot eyes above a HUGE wide open happy mouth, pink tongue, two thin bendy arms and two long thin legs, small playful golden crown. Warm coral-pink outer head, creamy pale face, rich burgundy mouth interior, soft pink tongue, plum outlines, rounded gold crown. Friendly mischievous expression, non-scary, no sharp teeth. Match high-quality painted children's storybook game sprites: clean softly textured gouache, bold readable silhouette, softly shaded edges, no pixel art, no photorealism. Transparent background, no checkerboard drawn, no ground/shadows/props/text. Each of the six cells must have generous empty margins; character same scale and proportions in each cell, feet aligned to identical relative baseline. Face toward LEFT (player approaches from the left). First row: 1 idle playful smile with short visible tongue; 2 warning cheeks puffed preparing tongue attack, hands raised; 3 attacking with mouth wide and a SHORT tongue stub pointed left (long tongue is rendered separately in the game). Second row: 4 tired vulnerable expression, drooping eyelids and limp arms; 5 hurt surprised blink, arms raised, no wounds; 6 defeated seated happily resting, still recognizable, no violence. All poses fully contained inside their individual cells, no overlap between cells. Wide head about twice torso height, thin long legs as in a child's original character. The atlas should be 1536x1024 or similar 3:2 landscape composition. No additional figures. This is a single sprite-sheet asset, not a presentation board.
